column1: # Vendor issues someone has looked at. The vendor-limits watchdog
# (scripts/check-vendor-limits.mjs) still shows them in every run, as
# warnings, until the date given, and fails only for a failing vendor
# row that is not here (or whose date has passed).
# One tab-separated line per vendor and status:
#   vendor (exactly as the run table names it)  status (WARN|BREACH|ERROR)  acknowledged_until (YYYY-MM-DD, UTC, inclusive)  note
# A different status for the same vendor is new, so a vendor that goes
# from ERROR to BREACH fails the run again.
# This repository is public: notes say what is known and who owns it,
